name: PT Argha Karya Prima Industry Tbk
summary: PT Argha Karya Prima Industry Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, produces and distributes flexible packaging films in Indonesia, the rest of Asia, America, Europe, Africa, the Middle East, Australia, and New Zealand. It operates through Manufacturing and Distribution segments. The company offers biaxially oriented polyethylene terephthalate films (BOPET), such as digital printing, barrier, paper lamination, clear, metallized, and coated films under the areta brand; biaxially oriented polypropylene (BOPP) films, including tobacco, straw, heat-sealable, and white cavitated films under the arlene brand; and polyester films.
